hero.headline:
X-Ray Detector
Manufacturing Services
hero.tagline: In-house detector manufacturing — from CMOS wafer to finished sensor.

overview.headline: Built in-house, from wafer to sensor.
overview.body1: Athlos manufactures its imaging sensors in-house and in partnership with the VTT Micronova cleanroom facility in Espoo — one of Europe's leading nanofabrication environments. This deep manufacturing capability is part of what makes Athlos sensors different: we control the full process, from detector material and bump bonding to final assembly and characterization.
overview.body2: The same manufacturing infrastructure that supports our own product lines is available as a service. Athlos can support partner and OEM projects requiring precision detector manufacturing, CMOS bumping, or specialized assembly processes.
overview.imageAlt: Silicon CMOS wafer with intricate detector grid pattern

bumping.title: Detector Bumping
bumping.body: Fine-pitch InSn solder bump deposition on CMOS wafers. Sub-100 µm pitch capability for CdTe and Si detector integration. Fine-pitch Cu pillar bump deposition on CMOS wafers. Sub-30 µm pitch capability for CdTe and Si detector integration.

flipChip.title: Flip Chip Bonding
flipChip.body: Precision flip chip interconnection of detector material to CMOS readout. Critical for achieving the direct electrical contact that enables direct conversion imaging.

wire.title: Wire Bonding
wire.body: High-density wire bond connections from CMOS die to PCB and packaging substrates. Suitable for fine-pitch and large-format sensor configurations.

probing.title: X-Ray Probing & Characterization
probing.body: Electrical probing at wafer level, including X-ray-based inspection. Full detector characterization for imaging uniformity, sensitivity, and noise performance.

dieBonding.title: Die Bonding & Assembly
dieBonding.body: Precision die bonding and multi-layer sensor assembly in controlled clean environments. Athlos coordinates all assembly stages in-house.

quality.title: Quality & Reliability
quality.body: ISO 13485:2016 quality management. Process controls at every manufacturing stage, from incoming material inspection to final product test and release.

facilities.headline: VTT Micronova cleanroom access.
facilities.body1: Athlos has full access to the 2,000 sqm VTT Micronova cleanroom facility in Espoo, Finland — one of Europe's most advanced nanofabrication, thin film, and microsystems cleanroom facilities.
facilities.body2: This partnership gives Athlos and its manufacturing customers access to a world-class facility, without the capital cost of a standalone cleanroom. Combined with Athlos's own assembly and characterization infrastructure, this enables full end-to-end sensor production.
facilities.imageAlt: Athlos cleanroom manufacturing facility at VTT Micronova, Espoo

cta.headline: Manufacturing partnership enquiries.
cta.body: If you are developing a detector-based product and need precision manufacturing support — from bump bonding to full sensor assembly — contact Athlos to discuss your requirements.
